levels.description: Attack Range expands, ATK <@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</>, prioritizes attacking enemies not under a burst effect; enemies that have received <$ba.dt.neural2>Nervous Impairment</> from Tragodia while skill is active take <@ba.vup>{ep_damage_ratio:0%}</> of ATK as <$ba.dt.neural2>Nervous Impairment</> per second until burst effect is triggered; enemies within attack range have <@ba.vup>+{talent@ep_break_recover_speed:0%}</> to their <$ba.dt.neural2>Nervous Impairment</> cooldown recovery rate; enemies entering the burst effect of <$ba.dt.neural2>Nervous Impairment</> will generate/refresh a Cage of Chaos at their ground position
